last.summary: Addressed the review's one request on projects/bzip2/spec/Bzip2/Spec/Format.lean: readSelectors' doc string now says it reads all nSelectors selectors but keeps only the first 18002, because the C decoder reads the rest without storing them (`if (i < BZ_MAX_SELECTORS)`) and then clamps nSelectors (decompress.c:299-306, read; BZ_MAX_SELECTORS = 2 + 900000/50 at bzlib_private.h:125). The same citation is added to the module doc next to the selector rule. The code (`codes.take 18002`) was already correct, so only the doc changed.
